# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Read and understand the check list fields and their purposes.
3. Compare it to the field notes that were taken during that site visit.
4. Read and understand the comments as they refer to failed checks or non-compliant requirements.
5. Read and understand the [Public Right of Way Accessibility Guidelines (PROWAG)](http://www.access-board.gov/proag/) section that addresses each non-compliance.
6. Consider reading the DOS’s design standards to understand their connection to non-compliant site conditions.
7. Review the figures that are found within the [ProWAG](http://www.access-board.gov/proag/) section to “confirm” the non-compliant condition(s).
